bootstrap.plan.generateClaudeMdWhy: Gives Claude your real commands, an architecture map and conventions at the start of every session.
bootstrap.plan.updateClaudeMdWhy: Brings CLAUDE.md back in line with the commands the project actually uses, and keeps it short.
bootstrap.plan.setupHooksWhy: Formats and lints every file Claude edits, so mistakes surface while Claude can still fix them.
bootstrap.plan.scaffoldTestsWhy: Adds a test runner and one example test, so changes can be checked by running them.
bootstrap.plan.addLinterWhy: Catches common mistakes in Claude's edits automatically.
bootstrap.plan.addFormatterWhy: Keeps edits in one style, so diffs show only real changes.
bootstrap.plan.generateCiWhy: Checks every change on GitHub Actions: install, lint, typecheck, test, build.
bootstrap.plan.smokeTestWhy: A quick check that the app still starts after a change.
bootstrap.plan.generatorSession: Generating runs a Claude session that can only read this workspace and run its test, lint, typecheck and build commands
bootstrap.plan.generatorProposes: It proposes files; nothing is written until you apply the proposal
bootstrap.plan.generatorPreview: Generate a proposal to see the exact files. Claude reads the project and proposes them; you review the diff here.
bootstrap.plan.generateFirst: Generate a proposal first (it costs a model call).
bootstrap.plan.installRolesWhy: The roles tasks run with (implementer, architect, reviewers, planners) as project agents, so the CLI and other Claude surfaces can use them too.
bootstrap.plan.gitInitWhy: Every later change can then be reviewed, reverted and rewound.
bootstrap.plan.untrackEnvWhy: Keeps the files on disk but out of future commits. They stay in past commits: rotate any secret they held.
bootstrap.plan.fixGitignoreWhy: A secret dropped into .env won't be committed by the next `git add .`.
bootstrap.plan.stopTestsTitle: Run the tests when Claude stops
bootstrap.plan.stopTestsWhy: After each turn, `{{command}}` runs; if tests fail, Claude gets the failures and fixes them before stopping. Slow test suites make every turn slower.
bootstrap.plan.linkAgentsMdWhy: Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md; importing AGENTS.md keeps one source of instructions for every agent.
bootstrap.plan.notReviewed: Not reviewed yet: needs {{reviews}} more maintainer review(s) against docs/CATALOG.md §4.
bootstrap.plan.downloads: Downloads {{binary}} {{version}} for {{platform}} from {{host}} (sha256 {{sha256}}…) into AgentChainer's tools folder; it stays there after a rollback
bootstrap.plan.copies: Copies {{path}} from {{repo}} at {{ref}} into {{targets}}, after checking it against the pinned tree sha256 ({{sha256}}…). Nothing else changes.
bootstrap.plan.copiesWithLicense: Copies {{path}} from {{repo}} at {{ref}} into {{targets}}, with its license notice ({{license}}, sha256 {{licenseSha256}}…), after checking it against the pinned tree sha256 ({{sha256}}…). Nothing else changes.
bootstrap.steps.noToolsDir: AgentChainer's tools folder isn't set up. Restart the app.
bootstrap.steps.invalidJson: {{label}} isn't valid JSON, so it can't be merged into. Fix it first.
bootstrap.gitHooks.notRepo: Not a git repository: initialize git first.
bootstrap.gitHooks.notTopFolder: Open the repository's top folder to add commit hooks.
bootstrap.gitHooks.ownHooksPath: Git uses its own hooks folder here (core.hooksPath = {{path}}): add the hook there yourself.
bootstrap.gitHooks.hooksOutside: This repository's hooks live outside the workspace (a worktree or submodule?).
bootstrap.gitHooks.existingHook: There's already a pre-commit hook in .git/hooks. Add the command to it, or use a hook manager such as lefthook.
bootstrap.gitSource.symlink: refusing a symlink in a catalog source: {{path}}
bootstrap.gitSource.licenseMissing: {{id}}'s license file {{path}} isn't in the source. Not installed.
bootstrap.gitSource.licenseNotFile: {{id}}'s license file {{path}} isn't a regular file. Not installed.
bootstrap.gitSource.licenseHashMismatch: Hash mismatch for {{id}}'s license: expected {{expected}}, got {{got}}. Not installed.
bootstrap.tools.downloadFailed: Couldn't download {{name}} {{version}} (offline or blocked by a proxy?): {{reason}}
bootstrap.tools.hashMismatch: {{name}} {{version}} failed its sha256 check (expected {{expected}}, got {{got}}). Not installed.
bootstrap.verify.noTestCommand: no test command detected after applying
bootstrap.verify.runnerMissing: The runner may not be installed yet: run the project's install command, then the tests.
bootstrap.verify.hookWorksTestsFail: the hook works; the tests fail now ({{seconds}} s), so Claude will be asked to fix them when it stops
bootstrap.verify.slowTests: the tests take {{seconds}} s, which every turn will wait for; consider a faster test command
bootstrap.generate.tooManyFiles: The generator proposed {{files}} files; at most {{max}}.
bootstrap.generate.pathNotAllowed: The generator proposed a path it may not write: {{path}}
bootstrap.generate.emptyPath: The generator proposed a path it may not write: (empty)
bootstrap.generate.skillMissing: Skill {{skill}} is missing from this build.
bootstrap.apply.outsideWorkspace: refusing a path outside the workspace: {{path}}
bootstrap.apply.notInPlan: Not in the current plan (already applied?)
bootstrap.apply.proposalStale: {{path}} changed since the proposal was made. Generate it again.
bootstrap.apply.noCliForPlugins: Claude Code CLI not found, so plugins can't be installed.
bootstrap.apply.marketplaceMissing: The {{marketplace}} marketplace isn't set up in your Claude CLI. Add it in your terminal: claude plugin marketplace add {{repo}}
bootstrap.apply.versionMovedOn: Installed {{version}}, but {{reviewed}} was reviewed: the marketplace moved on. Review the changes before relying on it.
bootstrap.apply.hashMismatch: Hash mismatch for {{id}}: expected {{expected}}, got {{got}}. Not installed.
bootstrap.apply.unsupportedGitStep: Unsupported install step for a git source: {{step}}
bootstrap.apply.alreadyExists: {{path}} already exists. Remove it first, or keep your own version.
bootstrap.apply.licenseClash: {{id}} already has a {{name}} in its files, so its license can't go next to them.
bootstrap.apply.unsupportedStep: Unsupported install step for a {{type}} source: {{step}}
bootstrap.apply.noCliForMcp: Claude Code CLI not found, so MCP servers can't be registered.
bootstrap.apply.installCommandChanged: the install command changed (now {{command}}); not run
bootstrap.apply.installCommandGone: the install command changed (now none); not run
bootstrap.apply.dependenciesInstalled: `{{command}}` exited {{code}} in {{seconds}} s; installed packages stay after a rollback (git ignores them)
bootstrap.apply.keptPlugin: plugin {{id}} (uninstall it with: claude plugin uninstall {{id}} --scope {{scope}})
bootstrap.apply.keptMcp: MCP server {{name}} (remove it with: claude mcp remove --scope {{scope}} {{name}})
bootstrap.apply.noRun: No bootstrap run {{runId}} in this workspace.
bootstrap.apply.notRecorded: Run {{runId}} wasn't recorded by AgentChainer ({{problem}}), so nothing was changed.
bootstrap.apply.notApplied: {{actionId}} isn't an applied action of run {{runId}}.
